_info: Template for a new launcher language. Copy this file to <code>.json (for example es-ES.json), write the name of the language in _language (as it is written in that language) and the code in _code, then translate the values. Keys are the English texts of the launcher and must stay exactly as they are; keep {0}, {1}... and \n. Empty values show in English.
_settings_descriptions: The texts below are the descriptions of the server settings. Without a translation the launcher shows the comment the server writes above each key of its .json files (in Portuguese; network.json has English and Portuguese).
